price_source: yfinance (free, read-only), 3 years of daily data

methodology.xd_next_date: Estimated as last year's XD date + 365 days (the earliest one that is still in the future). Confirmed only when a dated news source is listed. A note appears when XD is within 60 days.
methodology.xd_timing: For each past XD event: dividend payout (% of prior close); price move 5 and 10 trading days before and after XD; 20-day recovery of the pre-XD close. Entry A = buy 10 days before XD, hold through XD, sell 10 days after (dividend included, net of 10% withholding). Entry B = buy the day after XD, sell 10 trading days later. Fewer than 3 events = no timing view.
methodology.withholding: 10% assumed on dividends (usual rate for Thai individuals). Confirm for your own tax position.
caveats: Not backtested. Research only. No order is placed by this system.
XD statistics use 3 years; a typical item has 3 to 7 events, so small samples can mislead.
Next XD dates are estimates unless marked confirmed. Check the SET calendar before acting.
yfinance dividend data is incomplete for some names; the yield is flagged when history disagrees by more than 1 point.
Open-end mutual funds are excluded: no free long-run NAV history. Listed Thai funds (REITs, infrastructure, one ETF) are included.
Dated news is shown only where the source gives a date. Many search results were older or undated and are not used as current facts.
